textbook.chart.add(file(s), index) / replace(blockId, file) / remove / setHeight (S 280 / M 380 / L 560 / drag 200–900) / setCaption
dev.resetSampleData (development only)
import.localStorage(remi.v1, remi.textbook.v1). One-off.
UI-only state, never persisted: navigation, drawer, palette, hover, timeline zoom and pan, selected day, scrubber position, drafts, flash/moved animation flags, sidebar open.
proposedApi: All routes are served by the local Hono app bound to 127.0.0.1 under /api. Bodies are JSON and validated by schemas (zod) that are shared with the client. Mutation responses return the changed rows plus any derived deltas; the client re-derives the rest with the shared engine. IDs are server-generated UUIDs. Errors use {error:{code, message, field?}} with status 400, 404, 409 or 422.

GET /api/bootstrap — everything the SPA needs on load, for synchronous engine maths. Response {today:{iso, bdm, monthBDs, isBD}, settings, holidays[], calendar:{from, to, days: CalendarDay[]}, projects: ProjectAggregate[] (with charter, milestones, tasks, overrides, scope, checkins, risks, checklists, readinessItems), routines: Routine[] (with checklist items), routineRuns[], runTicks[], rotation:{startDate, hoursPerDay, segments[]}, notesIndex:{days:[{day, count, latestPreview}], total, dayCount}, feed: FeedEvent[] (latest 100), aliases[], derived:{loads, verdict, attention, upcoming, prompt, nextDue, daysToMove}}.
GET /api/calendar?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD — {days: CalendarDay[] (iso, w, bd, bdm, hol, isoWeek)}. Extends the range on demand; returns 422 outside the supported years.
GET /api/loads?from&to — {loads: {[iso]: DayLoad}}.

GET /api/move — Transition read model: {moveDate, moveLabel, daysToMove (business days strictly between today and the move), verdict, remainingDays[{iso, bdm, pcRunning}], flags[{kind: project|keyRun|move, projectId?, label, iso, status}], pcProjects[{id, name, readiness, forecast, deltaLabel, status, exitRoutes}], routines[{id, name, stage, note}], onboarding:{projectId, items[], doneCount}, rotationPreview{first3[], loopEnd}, afterDayOne[]}.

GET /api/today?date=YYYY-MM-DD — day plan read model: {day, kicker, bdm, monthBDs, load, bauRows[], checklistRun?:{routineId, items[{id, label, done}], editable}, focusBlocks[{projectId, hours, tasks[], emptyReason?, nextMilestone?}], nextRunAfter}. Optional, because the client can compute it with the engine.
GET /api/month-snapshot?month=YYYY-MM — {rows[{kind: bau|task|milestone, id, text, sub, due, done, doneOn}], bars[{iso, plan, done, late}], totals{total, done, late}}.
GET /api/home/summary — {today, bdm, daysToMove, projectCount, routineCount, notesToday, keyProject{name, forecast, deltaLabel}, textbook{pages, liveCharts}}.
GET /api/settings, PATCH /api/settings — Settings (validates moveDate, capacity 1..24, region enum).
GET /api/holidays?region&from&to, POST /api/holidays {date, name, region}, DELETE /api/holidays/:region/:date; GET/POST/DELETE /api/leave.
GET /api/projects — ProjectAggregate[] with derived fields (status, delta, since, stale, growth).
POST /api/projects {domain: 'pc'|'fi'} → 201 ProjectAggregate with the defaults, and an event project.created.
GET /api/projects/:id — ProjectAggregate.

PATCH /api/projects/:id {name?, short?, goal?, whyNow?, laterIntent?, targetDate?, targetLabel?, phase?, exitRoutes?, confidence?, readiness?, endName?, baselineHours?, bd3Hours?, bd8Hours?, rateAfterMove?, afterDayOneNote?} → {project, feed?: FeedEvent[]}. targetDate snaps to the next business day, clears targetLabel and logs a feed item. Changing phase logs a feed item. name also sets short unless short is sent.
POST /api/projects/:id/replan {rate?: number 0..24, workLeftHours?: number 0..999, startDate?: ISO} → {project, movement?:{from, to, deltaBD}}. This is refit.
DELETE /api/projects/:id → 204. Cascades. Returns 409 LAST_PROJECT if the UI requires at least one project (or handle an empty workspace).
PUT /api/projects/:id/overrides/:date {hours} and DELETE /api/projects/:id/overrides/:date.
POST /api/projects/:id/charter/:list {text?} → CharterItem; PATCH /api/charter-items/:id {text} (blank → 204 delete); DELETE /api/charter-items/:id; PUT /api/projects/:id/charter/:list/order {ids[]}.

POST /api/projects/:id/milestones {horizon: 'now'|'next', name?, dueDate?} (default due today+9 BD for now, +20 BD for next) → Milestone; PATCH /api/milestones/:id {name?, dueDate?, done?}; DELETE /api/milestones/:id (cascades tasks).

POST /api/milestones/:id/tasks {text?, hours? = 1} → Task; PATCH /api/tasks/:id {text?, hours? (0..24), done?} (done sets or clears doneAt); DELETE /api/tasks/:id; PUT /api/milestones/:id/tasks/order {ids[]}.

POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/projects/:id/risks[/:riskId] {risk, mitigation}; POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/projects/:id/checklists[/:clId] and /api/checklists/:clId/items[/:itemId] {text, done}; POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/projects/:id/readiness-items[/:itemId] {text, done, dueDate}.
GET /api/projects/:id/snapshots → [{checkinId, date, forecast, target, confidence, milestones[{id, name, date}]}] in date order.
POST /api/projects/:id/preview-shift {hours} → {delta, from, to, deltaLabel, vsTarget, newOverloadDays[{iso, total}], missesKeyRun, crossesMove}.

POST /api/checkins/parse {text, focusProjectId?} → {summary, changes: Change[], unplaced: string[], source: 'ai'|'simple'}. The server builds the context, calls the approved provider and runs validate(). Returns 503 AI_DISABLED when AI is off (the client offers the simple reading) and 502 AI_BAD_REPLY on malformed output. Must support AbortController cancellation.
POST /api/checkins/parse-simple {text, focusProjectId?} → the same shape, from the deterministic heuristic (no network).
POST /api/checkins/preview {changes: Change[]} → {perProject: [{projectId, from, to, deltaBD, late, label, targetAfter}]}. Uses the same maths as apply (or the client runs it with the shared engine).

POST /api/checkins/apply {changes: Change[], rawText?, focusProjectId?, source} → {projects: ProjectAggregate[], feed: FeedEvent[], routineRuns[], runTicks[], movements: [{projectId, from, to, deltaBD, cause: 'scope'|'rate'|'target'}]}. Runs in ONE DB transaction and writes a CheckIn with its snapshot per project.
POST /api/projects/:id/checkins {doneTaskIds[], changed, scopeWhat, scopeHours, blockers, confidence} → same response as apply. Structured form, only if it is rebuilt.
GET /api/routines → DerivedRoutine[] (rule, ruleShort, stageName, next[3]).

POST /api/routines {} → 201 Routine with defaults; PATCH /api/routines/:id {name?, short?, kind?, bd? (1..20), weekday? (1..5), hours? (0..capacity), stage? (0..3), statusNote?, detail?, projectId?, domain?} → {routine, feed?}. A stage change logs a feed item.
DELETE /api/routines/:id → 204, and logs 'Routine removed from the plan.' if the routine had a name.
GET /api/routines/:id/occurrences?from&to | ?after=ISO&limit=3 → [{iso, bdm, afterMove, today}].
PUT /api/routines/:id/runs/:date {completed: boolean} → RoutineRun. Rejects dates on which the routine does not occur.
PUT /api/routines/:id/runs/:date/items/:itemId {done} and PUT /api/routines/:id/runs/:date/items {done} (set all) → run ticks.
GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/routines/:id/checklist-items[/:itemId] {label, order}.

GET /api/rotation → {startDate, hoursPerDay, segments[{id, order, country, code, lengthBD, pass, start, end}], loopBD, loopEnd, refresh, current:{status: 'waiting'|'active'|'done', segmentId?, bdToStart?}}; PUT /api/rotation {hoursPerDay?, segments[]?} (future editing).
GET /api/notes?from&to → {days: {[iso]: NoteOut[]}}. NoteOut = {id, day, text, timeLabel, createdAt, updatedAt, tags[{targetType, targetId, label, domain}]}.
GET /api/notes/days?from&to → [{day, count, latestPreview, isBusinessDay, bdm, holiday, weekMonday}]; GET /api/notes/summary → {total, days}.
POST /api/notes {day, text} → 201 NoteOut; PATCH /api/notes/:id {text} (422 if empty; the client sends DELETE for blank); DELETE /api/notes/:id → 204.
GET /api/notes/recent?businessDays=5 → [{day, time, text}]. Also used server-side for the AI context.
GET /api/aliases; POST /api/aliases {entityType, entityId, alias}; DELETE /api/aliases/:id.
GET /api/feed?limit=50&before=cursor → FeedEvent[] (createdAt timestamps). POST /api/feed is internal only; services write feed entries.

GET /api/textbook → {sections[], pages[{id, sectionId, parentId, title, updatedAt, chartCount, childCount}]}; GET /api/textbook/home → {counts{pages, sections, charts, words}, recent[6], charts[3], sectionCards[]}; GET /api/textbook/search?q.

POST /api/textbook/sections {label?, accent?}; PATCH /api/textbook/sections/:id {label?, accent?, collapsed?}; DELETE /api/textbook/sections/:id (409 unless the section is empty and not the last); PUT /api/textbook/sections/order {ids[]}.

POST /api/textbook/pages {sectionId, parentId?, title?, replaceBlockId?} → {page, parentLinkBlock?}; GET /api/textbook/pages/:id → page with blocks; PATCH /api/textbook/pages/:id {title}; PUT /api/textbook/pages/:id/blocks {blocks[], baseVersion} (debounced autosave with optimistic concurrency, 409 on conflict); DELETE /api/textbook/pages/:id → {nextPageId}.

POST /api/textbook/charts (multipart .html/.htm, size limit, hash dedupe) → {assetId, name, sizeBytes}; GET /api/textbook/charts/:id/content → raw HTML, served with a restrictive CSP (ideally from a separate origin or port) for sandboxed iframes.
POST /api/import/local {remiV1?: object, textbookV1?: object} → {imported counts, warnings[]}. One-off migration.
POST /api/dev/reset-sample-data. Development builds only; reseeds the prototype sample data.
GET /api/events?since=cursor (optional). Returns the append-only RemiEvent log for history and debugging.
sharedComponents: Roll (odometer text). Used by Today (funds done, month done count), Projects (forecast), Timeline (row forecast), Workspace (start, target, forecast, to-land, 'plan as of'), Home (forecast, delta), Foundations demo. Columns need stable positional keys and must carry an accessible label.

Checkbox. Sizes: 18px (Today funds and tasks), 16px (month rows, Transition onboarding, drawer review rows), 15px (Workspace tasks). Border 1.5px, radius 3px. Done = ink background with a paper 'check' glyph. Glyph opacity transitions 140ms; scale 0.4→1 over 180ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.5,0.64,1), no scale under reduced motion. The label turns ink-muted with a line-through in var(--done).

CapacityBar. Variants:
- day, 14px (Today)
- panel, 12px (Calendar panel)
- week mini, 6px (Today week strip)
- cell meter, 5px (Calendar)
- vertical strip, 5px/h (Timeline)
- Home decorative strip
It is built by the shared segment builder: notched BAU, soft project, outlined free, 8h marker, overload colours and one pulse.

DeltaChip. Examples: '+3 BD' (risk tint 22%/40%), '−N BD' and 'On target' (neutral hairline), 'no plan', '+N BD vs target', 'moved +N BD'. Used in Projects, Timeline, Workspace, Transition, the drawer EffectChip and the Foundations FeedItem (which uses 20%/45%). Standardise on one recipe.
StaleBadge / status chip. Example: 'Stale · 9 days', inset risk 45%/paper ring with a hollow dot. Used in Projects and the Foundations GoalStatement.
DomainTag / DomainChip. 22px, soft background, 6px accent dot, 11/600 with 0.04em tracking. Used in the Workspace header, Timeline side panel, drawer focus chip and Foundations.
DomainDot and section header (7px dot + 15/600 or 20/600 title + muted note, 1px ink bottom rule). Used in Projects groups, Routines, Transition columns and Notes mentions.
Eyebrow label. 11px/600, 0.08em letter-spacing, uppercase, ink-muted. Used on every screen.
SectionTitleRow. 20/600 title with a right-hand note, 1px ink bottom rule, padding-bottom 10px. Used in Today (plan, week, month), Workspace (Charter, Plan) and Textbook Home.
BauChip. 20px, soft background, 3x10 accent tick, 11/500, e.g. 'Returns · 6h'. Used in Today week cards, Calendar cells and Foundations.

MilestoneDiamond. 7–10px, rotated 45°, 1.5px accent border, filled once passed. Also ForecastEndDiamond (14px with a 2px paper knockout ring, risk colour when late), a flash ghost diamond (18px dashed) and TargetMarker (Γ flag: 1px ink vertical + 7px top bar). Used in Timeline, the Workspace scrubber, Calendar, Today, Transition flags and Home.

TimelineBar. States: on track, at risk (bar to target + risk overrun), done (--done), ghost (dashed previous plan), no plan yet (hatched 135° soft). Used in Timeline, the Workspace scrubber, Home and Foundations.
BauTick. 4px, radius 2. Filled normally; outlined once handed over or after the move. Used in Timeline and Foundations.
RotationSegment. Build = solid border + soft fill; Refresh = dashed, no fill. Used in Timeline.
RotationTile. Mono index·code, pass pill, country 16–18/500, date range. The current tile has a 1.5px ink border and a flag. Used in Routines (10), Transition (3) and Foundations.
ConfidencePips (read-only meter). 5 pips: 10x8 in Projects, 12x8 in Workspace. Filled pips are ink, empty ones hairline, plus an 'N/5' label.
ConfidenceControl (1–5 picker, 52x40 buttons). Only in Foundations and the legacy structured check-in.
Stepper controls. SegmentedControl (Timeline zoom pill with a sliding ink indicator; Routines kind Monthly/Weekly/Daily; Textbook chart S/M/L); BD stepper (− BDn +); WeekdayPicker (Mon–Fri).

HandoverStepper / PhaseStepper. Dots joined by connectors: past = filled ink, current = hollow ink with 600-weight label, future = ink-faint. Used in Routines; the phase stepper exists in the Foundations spec and is unrendered in the Workspace.

InlineEditable (input / auto-grow textarea). Draft/commit pattern: commit on blur or Enter; Escape reverts and stops propagation; blank removes or reverts. Hover background ink 3–4%; focus paper-raised with an inset hairline. Used in Workspace (all fields), Routines (name, hours, note), Notes entries and Textbook blocks. Needs a JS autosize fallback because field-sizing is Chromium-only.

BusinessDayDatePicker. 292px popover: Monday-first grid, 'BD{n}' sub-labels, weekend and holiday tooltips, picks snap to the next business day, 'Today' button, note line. Used in Workspace start, target and milestone dates.

SidePanel / Sheet (right slide-in, no scrim). Timeline project panel 460px; Calendar day panel 440px. translateX(104%) → 0 over 440ms spring, opacity 240ms. Content must stay mounted during the exit animation.
Drawer (right, with scrim). Check-in drawer 1160px (max calc(100% − 160px)) over an ink 18% scrim.
CommandPalette. 680px, grouped rows with dot, label and mono hint.
HoverTooltip. 280–300px, paper-raised, hairline border, radius 6, shadow 0 12px 28px -18px ink 40%. Used in Timeline (cursor-following) and Foundations.

Buttons:
- Primary: ink background, paper text, 36–40px, radius 6, active scale 0.98, hover ink 86% mixed with paper.
- Outline: 1px ink or hairline border; the Workspace Tell Remi outline inverts on hover.
- Ghost / icon button.
- Text link with north_east icon: 'Routine ↗', 'Workspace ↗', 'Via … ↗', 'Whole rotation ↗'.
- '+ Add' small ghost buttons.

synthesis.motionSystem:
Principles, from Foundations:
- 'Alive, never busy. Motion explains a change; nothing loops.'
- Nothing runs longer than 600ms.
- Use ease-out for opacity and colour. These fades are kept under reduced motion.
- Use the spring for layout and movement. It becomes instant under reduced motion.

Tokens:
- --dur-fast 140ms: feedback, hover, press, tick fill, linked highlight.
- --dur-base 240ms: fades, cross-fades, segmented pills.
- --dur-slow 440ms: glides, zoom, drawers.
- --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1).
- --spring-soft: a critically damped linear() curve with no overshoot, always run at 440ms. It is roughly Motion {type:'spring', bounce:0, visualDuration:0.35}, i.e. stiffness 180, damping 27.
- Implement mostly as CSS transitions keyed off state. The prototype relies on stable DOM nodes, so inline style changes animate from the old computed value. Keep keys stable, especially Roll columns and chart elements.

Reduced motion:
- One source of truth: the OS prefers-reduced-motion setting OR a user setting. This sets :root[data-motion='reduced'].
- --spring-soft becomes steps(1, jump-start), so spatial transitions jump.
- Remove JS-driven translates: arrival offsets, day or month switch slides, and the hover lift.
- Remove the overload pulses, the checkbox scale pop and the moved-chip scale.
- View transitions get 0s duration.
- Smooth scroll becomes auto.
- Opacity and colour fades remain.
- The prototype is inconsistent here (model.reduced only reads the tweak prop); fix that.

1. Screen switching
- All screens stay mounted, so local state and scroll position survive a switch.
- Entering screen: opacity 0→1 over 240ms ease-out after a 60ms delay; visibility flips immediately.
- Leaving screen: opacity 1→0 over 140ms ease-out; visibility becomes hidden at 140ms.
- If production unmounts screens on route change, it must restore scroll and state and emulate this cross-fade.

2. Card to workspace shared-element transition (View Transitions API)
- Sequence:
  1. Set vtPhase='from' on the clicked card; its goal gets view-transition-name 'remi-goal'.
  2. Call document.startViewTransition(() => a promise that resolves after the DOM commits screen=workspace, vtPhase='to', instant=true). The workspace goal textarea is now named 'remi-goal', and the section cross-fade is disabled.
  3. When finished, clear the vt state and set instant=false.
- CSS:
  - ::view-transition-group(remi-goal): 420ms, cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1).
  - old and new remi-goal: height 100%, width auto, object-fit none, object-position left top (the text grows from top-left without stretching).
  - root: 220ms.
- Skip it when reduced, when startViewTransition is unsupported, when not triggered from a card, or when already on the workspace.
- The goal grows from 26px in the list to 44px.

3. Arrival (first mount only, after a double requestAnimationFrame)
- Today: 5 blocks, opacity 0→1 and translateY(6px)→none over 140ms ease-out, delays 0/40/80/120/160ms. The capacity bar grows from 0 (440ms spring, 90ms delay). Week mini bars grow with a 160ms delay. Month bars grow with an i×8ms stagger.
- Projects: header fades and slides (140ms). Group headers fade (20ms, 120ms). Rows slide 6px with delays of 40 + i×30ms.
- Timeline:
  - bars grow from width 0 (440ms spring, row delay i×30+60ms);
  - rotation segments start at 200 + i×20ms;
  - capacity columns stagger round(i×2.5)ms;
  - diamonds scale 0→1 (240ms ease-out);
  - after 900ms, all delays become 0.
- Home:
  - header 200ms;
  - greeting 180ms opacity + 260ms spring;
  - H1 at +40ms;
  - cards 220ms opacity at +120 and +170ms, 360ms spring;
  - capacity bars i×12ms;
  - Gantt rows i×50+80ms;
  - footer at +240ms.
- Foundations spec: '140 ease-out per block · 40 stagger · 340 total, first load only.'
- Decide whether arrival replays on the first view of a screen. In the prototype it plays hidden at app load.

4. 'The plan moves' (signature, after a check-in)
- The drawer closes immediately. Changes apply 220ms later so the eye is back on the plan. Only the affected bars move.
- Glide: forecast bar width, overrun, end diamond and moved chip 'left' animate over 440ms spring.
- Ghost:
  - the previous-plan dashed bar goes to opacity 1 while flash is set (1100ms), then rests at 0.55 for as long as prev exists;
  - the dashed ghost end diamond and 'was 27 Nov' label appear instantly (0ms), hold, then fade over 400ms ease-out.
- Roll: date digits, weekday and month roll over 440ms spring.
- Delta chip: '+N BD' fades in (180ms) and scales 0.9→1 (180ms ease-out, origin left). It holds for 5200ms (moved), then fades. The label is cached so the text survives the fade.
- The Workspace 'moved +N BD' badge follows the same rules. The forecast late tint animates its background over 440ms ease-out.
- A new check-in on the same project restarts the timers.

5. Linked highlight
- Hovering a project, routine or 'rot' anywhere dims unrelated elements. Opacity transitions over 140ms ease-out.
- Target opacity should be one value (Foundations says 0.28; screens currently use 0.25–0.55).

6. Overlays
- Drawer: panel translateX(104%)↔0 over 440ms spring, plus opacity over 240ms. Scrim fades over 240ms ease-out. Textarea autofocuses at 380ms.
- Palette: scrim 140ms; panel opacity 140ms plus translateY(-8px)→0 over 240ms spring; input focused at +30ms.
- Side panels (Timeline 460px, Calendar 440px): translateX(104%)↔0 over 440ms spring plus opacity 240ms. Keep content mounted during exit.
- Date picker: instant. Tooltip: opacity 140ms, position follows the cursor with no transition.

7. Local transitions
- Today day switch: left column fades to 0 (120ms ease-out) and translateX(dir×-8px) over 240ms spring. Swap at 120ms, then return.
- Notes day switch: opacity 140ms and translateY(dir×6px) over 240ms spring. Swap at 120ms; focus the composer at +40ms.
- Calendar month change: opacity 140ms and translateX(dir×-10px) over 240ms spring. Swap at 130ms. Panel prev/next steps change instantly.
- Timeline zoom and pan: every x and width transitions over 440ms spring. Month labels cross-fade 240ms when narrower than 70px. The zoom pill slides over 240ms spring. Pan controls fade 240ms.
- Workspace scrubber:
  - while dragging, values recompute on every pointermove and the springy transitions lag slightly behind;
  - the handle has no transition while dragging and springs 440ms on release;
  - milestones cross-fade by snapshot membership;
  - the body dims to 0.35 over 240ms;
  - hover labels fade over 140ms.
- Capacity segments: width 440ms spring; opacity 140ms.
- Overload pulse: remi-pulse 600ms ease-out, one iteration. Delays: Today bar 300ms, week bar 400ms, Timeline 450ms, Calendar cell 300ms, Calendar panel 200ms. Foundations says 450ms. It does not replay when switching between two overloaded days (same animation string); a keyed restart could fix this.

8. Controls and small feedback
- Checkbox tick: background and border 140ms; glyph opacity 140ms; scale 0.4→1 over 180ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.5,0.64,1); label colour 240ms; strike-through instant. Foundations and remi-tick disagree (0.6→1.08→1); reconcile.
- Confidence pips: background 240ms.
- Progress fills: width 440ms spring.
- Routines stage dots: 240ms.
- Fresh row flash: accent 8% held 1200/1600ms, background fades over 440ms. Notes version: 7% held 1400ms, fades over 900ms.
- Transition flags: left 440ms spring. Ticks: background 240ms.
- Buttons: nav colours 140ms; primary active scale(0.98), instant; hover instant unless stated.

9. Check-in drawer internals
- Thinking bar: 0→88% over 2600ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1).
- Echo lines: opacity and translateY(4px) over 240ms, staggered i×180ms.
- Review groups: opacity 220ms plus translateY(6px) over 320ms spring, staggered k×70ms.
- Row toggle: opacity 1↔0.55 over 140ms.

10. Home
- Card hover: lift -4px (360ms spring), box-shadow border 240ms, arrow nudge 2px spring.
- CAP to CAPH bars re-stagger. Overrun width animates.
- Typewriter: max-width 0→9ch, steps(9) over 520ms.
- Slash menu: opacity 200ms plus translateY(-4px) over 320ms spring, delayed 560ms on enter and 0ms on exit.
- Expand overlay:
  - place the overlay over the card at radius 6, then fade it in over 140ms;
  - at +120ms animate left, top, width, height and radius to the full stage over 420ms spring;
  - navigate at +520ms.
- Going home from the app or Textbook: fade opacity over 180ms ease-out, then navigate.

11. Textbook
- Sidebar: grid columns 288↔56 over 440ms spring; panel translateX(-24px) with opacity.
- Chevrons: rotate over 240ms spring.
- Page swap: fade 140ms plus translateY(6px) over 240ms spring, swap at 120ms.
- Home cards: stagger i×50ms.
- New block: held at opacity 0 and translateY(4px) for 60ms, then animated in (220ms opacity, 320ms spring).
- Iframe height: 440ms spring.
- Toast: opacity 240ms plus translateY(8px) over 440ms spring.
- Drop overlay: 140ms.
synthesis.aiIntegration:
CURRENT FLOW (CheckIn.dc.html)

1. The user opens Tell Remi. Entry points:
   - the header button (focus = workspace project, else none);
   - palette 'Tell Remi about X';
   - palette quick-add '+6h returns', which prefills 'New scope on <short>, about 6h: ';
   - the Timeline panel, the Workspace, and the Projects 'Check in now' button;
   - Notes 'Turn this day into an update', which prefills 'HH:MM text' lines.
2. The user types free text and presses Send or ⌘↵.
3. The client calls:
   window.claude.complete({system: SYS, max_tokens: 1800, messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'CONTEXT\n' + JSON.stringify(context) + '\n\nUPDATE\n' + text}]})
   No model id, temperature or streaming is set.

The CONTEXT payload:
- today: 'YYYY-MM-DD (Monday 5 October, BD3)'
- focus_project: project id or null
- projects[], each with: {id, name, short, domain (display name), forecast, target, hours_per_day, confidence, open_tasks: [{id, text, hours}] (undone Now tasks only), milestones: ['name (date)']}
- routines[], each with: {id, name, rule text, runs_today}
- recent_notes: every note from the last 5 business days up to today, formatted 'Fri 2 Oct 16:10: text'

The system prompt (verbatim in CheckIn.dc.html lines 127–145):
- It asks for a single JSON object {summary, changes[], unplaced[]}.
- It defines nine change types with examples: task_done, task_add, scope_add ('a day' = 8h), blocker, confidence (1–5, only if stated), target_move (YYYY-MM-DD), hours_per_day, note (20 words max), bau_done (a routine that runs today).
- It says recent_notes are background only.
- Rules: be conservative and never invent work; match by name, short name or obvious reference; focus_project captures remarks that name no other project; resolve relative dates against today; at most one note per project; prefer task_done over note.

4. Reply handling:
   - Take the greedy match /\{[\s\S]*\}/ and JSON.parse it.
   - Run validate(). Its rules (id existence, open-task ownership, clamps and length limits, confidence must differ from the current value, target snapped to the next business day and inside the calendar, 0 < hours_per_day <= 8, bau_done only if the routine runs today, dedupe) are in engineAlgorithms.
   - If window.claude is absent, the 'simple reading' regex parser runs instead.
   - Any other error shows an error panel with 'Try again' and 'Use a simple reading'.
5. Review: changes are grouped per project, each shown with a live forecast EffectChip. The user unticks anything wrong.
6. Apply: saveCheckIn closes the drawer and applies the accepted changes 220ms later (applyUpdate, then applyCheckIn).

PRODUCTION DESIGN

- Move the AI call server-side: POST /api/checkins/parse. The browser never holds credentials. SPEC: 'the server can later … hold AI credentials'.
- core/config holds:
  - aiProvider: 'none' | 'anthropic' | 'firm-gateway' (e.g. Claude through a firm-approved cloud tenancy) | 'local' (an on-device model);
  - model id, timeout and max tokens (1800);
  - aiSendRecentNotes (boolean);
  - redaction options.
- The context is built server-side from the DB, not trusted from the client.
- Use structured output: tool use with a JSON schema for the Change union, instead of the greedy regex. Validate with the shared zod schema and then the validate() business rules, and return {summary, changes, unplaced, source}.
- Keep the deterministic 'simple reading' fallback, and make it the default when AI is off. Generalise it: keywords come from the EntityAlias table plus project and routine names and short names, not the hard-coded ret/manco/play/fion/alpha/r-ret lists. Unify it with the Notes tagger.
- Fix the fallback quirks:
  - blocker text is lower-cased;
  - a note is added alongside task_done;
  - both scope_add and hours_per_day come from the same sentence.
- Support cancellation (AbortController) and a session guard, so a late reply cannot land in a newly opened drawer.
- Keep the review-before-apply contract: AI output is only ever a proposal. Store the accepted changes with rawText and source on the CheckIn record and in the event log.
- Apply runs in one server transaction and returns movements for the animation.
- Decide on the structured form: SPEC §7.4 and the brief wanted a structured form with live preview (screenshot 02-sig), plus the free-text box as the future state. The code ships only the free-text flow. If the structured form is rebuilt, it uses POST /api/projects/:id/checkins and preview-shift.

'STAY LOCAL' IMPLICATIONS (SPEC: 'Nothing leaves the Mac'; open question 6)

- Each AI parse sends the following off the machine:
  - the free text;
  - every project's name, short name, dates, hours per day and confidence;
  - open task text and hours;
  - milestone names and dates;
  - routine names and rules;
  - full text of the last 5 business days of notes.
  It does NOT send goals, charters or risks.
- This needs compliance sign-off on which route is permitted: a firm-approved Claude route, a local model, or none.
- Until sign-off, ship with aiProvider = 'none' (simple reading only). Show a clear indicator of which provider is in use. Consider an audit log of exactly what was sent, and a toggle to exclude notes.
- The Notes rail copy 'Notes from your last five business days go along with every Tell Remi update' must reflect the real setting.

OTHER NETWORK EGRESS TO REMOVE FOR STAY-LOCAL

- Google Fonts and Material Symbols: self-host.
- React, ReactDOM and Babel from unpkg: bundle them.
- KaTeX from jsDelivr: bundle it.
- Textbook live-chart iframes run arbitrary user HTML with scripts and network access (the sample chart fetches Google Fonts). Serve chart content with a restrictive CSP (connect-src 'none', font and style limited to self), or from an isolated local origin, and keep sandbox='allow-scripts' without allow-same-origin.
- Future integrations (Outlook meetings reducing capacity, Excel import) belong in the server and likely need IT sign-off.
synthesis.persistenceToday:
Everything lives in browser localStorage. There is no backend.

1) 'remi.v1', written by Remi.dc.html (the app shell)

The whole-state JSON blob:
- projects: Project[] in stored shape (not derived);
- tasks: {taskId: boolean};
- doneOn: {taskId: ISO};
- feed: FeedEvent[], where 'when' is a display string such as 'Just now' or 'Sat 3 Oct' and ids are 'f' + Date.now();
- funds: boolean[12], today's returns-run ticks, not keyed by date;
- routines: Routine[];
- bauDone: {'<routineId>:<ISO occurrence>': ISO done date};
- notes: {ISO day: [{id: 'n' + base36, t: 'HH:MM', text}]};
- m2: true.

Loading:
- The blob is read once at module evaluation.
- It is accepted only if projects is an array. Otherwise each slice falls back to its seed: BASE_PROJECTS, ROUTINES, BASE_FEED, funds with the first 5 ticked, tasks {ret-1, fi-1}, BASE_NOTES, and BASE_DONE_ON {ret-1: 2026-10-01, fi-1: 2026-10-02}.
- normalize() and normR() fill in defaults.
- Migration m2 inserts task man-0 ('Send the NAV bridge spec to Finance', 0.5h, due 2026-10-02) at the start of manco now[0] when it is missing.

Saving:
- In componentDidUpdate, a 250ms debounce fires when any of the 8 slices changes by reference.
- Errors (quota, private mode) are swallowed.
- The very first state change after mount is skipped.

Resetting:
- 'Reset to sample data' in the palette removes the key and restores the seeds.

Not persisted: screen, ws, hover, drawer, palette, flash/moved, the view-transition state and requests. A reload always opens Today with ws = 'ret'.

2) 'remi.textbook.v1', written by Remi Textbook.dc.html

Shape: {cur, pages: [{id, section, parent?, title, updated, blocks: [...]}], sections: [{id, label, accent}], secCollapsed}.
- Chart HTML is stored inline as strings.
- The seed chart uses the src marker 'charts/price-yield.html', hydrated from the SAMPLE_CHART constant.
- Saved with a 350ms debounce on every mutation, including navigation and each resize pointermove.
- On a quota error it shows a toast.
- cur is forced to '__home' on load.

3) Remi Home.dc.html is read-only. It reads both keys for its counts, using the hard-coded key notes['2026-10-05'].

4) Foundations has no persistence.

ID generation relies on Date.now() and base36, so collisions are possible.

Production:
- Replace all of this with SQLite behind the local API, with the event log as the source of truth.
- Provide a one-off import endpoint for both blobs.
hardcodedToGeneralise: TODAY is fixed at 2026-10-05 (Mon, BD3). Use the real date in the business timezone, with an optional demo override. addNote already uses the real clock for its time, so notes currently mix the real time with the fake date.

# Completeness review: omissions and corrections to the unified build spec

Paths are relative to `/Users/justinstoddart/Desktop/Ninety One/remi/Remi Dashboard Design Review/`. Line numbers refer to the `.dc.html` files. I read every file in full, including `support.js` (only the pseudo-class handling is relevant). Most of what follows is missing copy and small behaviours. A few items are outright errors in the spec, and they are marked **CORRECTION**.

## Keyboard (consolidated; the spec misses several)
- Calendar.dc.html:131: Escape closes the day panel, but only when `screen === 'calendar'`. It is a window listener, so it also fires alongside the shell's Escape.
- Workspace.dc.html:297: Escape closes the date picker. It listens in the capture phase and calls `stopPropagation`, so it does not also close the drawer or palette.
- Inline fields call `e.stopPropagation()` on Escape (Workspace:324, Routines:187, Notes:185, Textbook:630). The result is that Escape reverts the field and does not close an overlay. Keep this.
- CheckIn.dc.html:10 and :323: the ⌘/Ctrl+Enter handler is attached to the drawer root, so it only works when focus is inside the drawer. In the **error** phase, ⌘↵ retries (it calls `send`).
- Textbook:
  - :392: Escape closes fullscreen first, then the slash menu.
  - :664: Enter or ArrowDown in the title moves focus to the first text block, or inserts a `p` if there is none.
  - :513: Enter in formula edit exits edit mode, then focuses the next text block or inserts a `p`.
  - :516: Enter on an empty bullet or callout converts it to `p`.
  - :519: Enter on a heading splits into a `p`; Enter on a bullet splits into a bullet.
  - :622–630: section rename commits on Enter and reverts on Escape.
- Remi Home.dc.html:154: the `1`/`2` keys have no modifier guard.

# Remi screenshots: visual spec for each screen

**Scope.** I looked at 71 PNGs in `/Users/justinstoddart/Desktop/Ninety One/remi/Remi Dashboard Design Review/screenshots/`. Every file is 924×540 and scaled down, so small text is hard to read and hex values are approximate. They were taken with ImageMagick and are blurred at the edges. Where they disagree with the CSS tokens, use the code.

**Filenames don't always match the screen.**
- `tr` is the **Tell Remi** drawer. The Transition screen is `04-pass1.png`.
- `sig` is the forecast change shown after a check-in, on Timeline and Today.
- `month.png` is a Today variant.
- `02-pass1` is Calendar, `03-pass1` and `01/02-pass2` are Routines, and `nophase`/`01-pass1` are the Projects list.
- `rlink` is Routines plus the Today log.
- `dp` is the date picker and `hv` is hovering the plan strip.

## Global shell (every screen except Home and Textbook)

**Colours sampled from the images:**

| Use | Approx. hex |
|---|---|
| Page background | `#FAF5F1` (warm off-white) |
| Browser chrome | `#EDE8E4` |
| Home cards | `#FFFDF8` |
| Ink / primary button | `#28231F` (near-black) |
| Private Credit (PC) green | `#536C33`–`#5A7437` |
| Fixed Income (FI) blue | `#4F5E89` |
| Late/overrun amber | `#D4923E` |
| Amber chip background | `#F0E1CA` |
| "Overload" chip background | `#FFE5C7` |
| Capacity cream | `#E8E5D4` |
| Over-8h peach | `#F0B19F`, `#F4D7AF` |
| Overload red | brick red, about `#A8463A` (the sample was blurred) |
| Forecast cell tint | `#FFF7F0` |
| Drawer scrim | page turns about `#D4CFCB`, i.e. roughly `rgba(40,35,31,.18)` |

**Left rail (about 42px):**
- "Remi" wordmark in serif at the top.
- Icon over a tiny label, in this order: Today, Timeline, Calendar, Projects, Routines, Transition.
- `notes.png` alone adds "Notes" between Today and Timeline.
- The active item gets a white rounded tile with a thin border.
- "⌘K" search icon at the bottom.

**Top bar (about 44px, hairline underneath):**
- `Mon 5 Oct` (bold sans), then `BD3` (mono, grey).
- A vertical divider, then **61** (bold) followed by "business days to Fixed Income".
- A status: `● Move on track, narrowly`. Other versions read "Move on track" or "Move at risk".
- Right side: search field "Jump to or add" with a `⌘K` key hint, and a black "≡ Check in" button. On Notes the button reads "Tell Remi".

**Type:**
- **Display serif**, a transitional serif, for page titles and project goals.
- **High-contrast serif italic** for goal quotes, the "Later" intent and example phrases.
- **Grotesque sans** for the interface.
- **Small mono** for BD numbers, dates, hours, ranges and chips (`0d target`, `+3 BD`, `8.5h`, `next 2 weeks · 5–16 Oct`).
- **Eyebrows** are about 9px uppercase sans, letter-spaced and grey.

**Rhythm.** Section headings are sans at about 15px with a 1px dark rule underneath. Rows are separated by hairlines. Density is high but calm. There are no shadows except on popovers and drawers.

## 1. Home (`01/02/03-home.png`)

**Layout:**
- Centred, full-bleed, no rail.
- Header: "Remi" on the left; `Mon 5 Oct · BD3 | 61 business days to Fixed Income` on the right, with a hairline below.
- Eyebrow: "GOOD EVENING · MONDAY 5 OCTOBER".
- Huge serif H1, about 52px: "Where to this morning?"
- Grey two-line intro: "Plan the move to Fixed Income in the Control Panel, or write things down properly in the Textbook."

**Two equal cards** (`#FFFDF8`, about 1px border, about 6px radius, gap about 24px):

- **Card 01, Control Panel**
  - Small "01" beside the serif title (about 26px).
  - Subtitle: "Today, the timeline, projects, routines and the move, recalculated as you go."
  - A mini timeline: a row of cream capacity blocks (one peach, which becomes three peach on hover), a "FI move" line in blue, 4 green bars and 1 blue bar with white diamonds, an orange overrun stub, and a hatched blue bar at the end.
  - Footer: "Returns pipeline Wed 2 Dec `+3 BD`" and "5 projects · 2 routines · 4 notes today".
- **Card 02, Textbook**
  - Small "02" beside the title, plus an outlined mono chip "IN THE WORKS".
  - Subtitle: "Notes you can build a career on…".
  - A document preview: breadcrumb "FIXED INCOME / Rates primer", then "1 Rates and duration", then "1.1 Price and yield", then an italic formula "ΔP / P ≈ −D × Δy".
  - `03-home` catches a typing demo mid-way: "1.2 Convexity|" with a slash-toolbar "/ Heading · Formula · Callout · Link to project". In `01-home` the "1.2" line is still faint.
  - Footer: "Numbered sections · formulas · linked to projects".

**Card hover:** the border darkens to about `#8a8580` and the circular → button fills black with a white arrow (Control Panel in `02-home`, Textbook in `03-home`). In `02-home` the mini-chart plays a scenario: forecast rolls to "Fri 4 Dec `+5 BD`", the orange stub gets longer and more peach blocks appear.

**Footer:** "Press `1` for the Control Panel" on the left (key cap) and "A personal instrument. Nothing here is shared." on the right.

The selected day has a white card with a dark top border.

Overdue items show "overdue 1 BD" in bold, and there is a "Show 8 more and 2 done" link.
